title: The same for an English-speaking owner: the jobs on the first try, the answer in English
note: The history and settings are in the case (next to it is hub-schedule-owner-time on the hub's journal). The owner's time zone is deliberately not the machine's; it is chosen far from midnight for the run — otherwise "until the end of today" is ambiguous. Only the hub's jobs count: the core sets its own too.

data.text: In 3 minutes remind me to check that the schedule works. And set yourself a job every 5 minutes until the end of today: write in one line how many sessions are alive.
